entries.17d66f6eeb3ac78b: This business makes equipment for viewing the inside of the body in hospitals. It handles angiography systems, X-ray TV systems, general radiography systems, mobile ward-round systems that can be moved to patients' rooms, surgical X-ray TV systems used in operating rooms, PET systems, near-infrared optical camera systems, radiation therapy-related equipment and medical information systems. The business traces its origins to 1909, when Japan's first medical X-ray apparatus was completed. Manufacturing is carried out by Shimane Shimadzu Co., Ltd. and local subsidiaries in the United States, Germany and China, while domestic sales and maintenance services are handled by Shimadzu Medical Systems Corporation. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥73,794 million, the second largest by revenue, but segment profit of ¥4,871 million was the smallest of the four reportable segments, making this a business whose rankings differ greatly between revenue and profit. The number of employees was 1,982 (excluding 170 temporary employees). The company explains that revenue increased 1.7% year on year and operating profit increased 14.3% year on year, which is the second largest increase in profit growth rate after the Aircraft Equipment Business.

entries.751754333107e159: This is a business not included in the reportable segments. Note 1 to the securities report states: “The ‘Others’ category comprises business segments not included in reportable segments, and includes businesses such as real estate leasing, real estate management and construction and flooring.” Shimadzu Sogo Service Co., Ltd. and Taihei Kogyo Co., Ltd. carry these out. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥7,130 million, segment profit was ¥1,180 million, and the number of employees was 932 (excluding 203 temporary employees). Revenue fell 5.8% year on year, while operating profit rose sharply, up 87.2% year on year. In addition, there are 1,102 corporate (common) employees not allocated to a specific business (excluding 252 temporary employees), and the consolidated total is 14,649 (excluding 1,585 temporary employees).

entries.98966988fe757b31: This business makes machinery and equipment used inside factories. Products include turbomolecular pumps that evacuate air to create a vacuum, hydraulic gear pumps, control valves, power packages, industrial furnaces, liquid transfer pumps, glass winders, dynamic balancing machines (balancing machines), helium leak detectors and high-speed sputtering systems, as well as unusual products such as magnetic detectors / magnetometers, underwater optical wireless devices and optical lattice clocks. They are made by Shimadzu Sanki Systems Co., Ltd., Shimadzu Precision Technology Co., Ltd., Tianjin Shimadzu Hydraulic Co., Ltd. and others. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥71,523 million, slightly below the Medical Equipment Business, but segment profit of ¥10,595 million ranks second after the Measuring Instruments Business, so this is a business whose profit ranking is higher than its revenue ranking. The number of employees was 1,282 (excluding 274 temporary employees). The company explains that revenue fell 1.1% year on year, the only decline among the four reportable segments, while operating profit rose 1.2% year on year. Order intake was ¥74,609 million, exceeding revenue, and order backlog rose 21.3% year on year to ¥17,553 million.
